intent: Load the CITE-seq filtered feature-barcode matrix (RNA genes plus antibody-derived tag features, 10x v3 layout) into a single AnnData, save it as cite_seq.h5ad, and write a table of the loaded features to loaded_features.tsv.
silent_error: scanpy.read_10x_mtx has gex_only=True by default: every feature whose type is not 'Gene Expression' (Antibody Capture, CRISPR Guide Capture, Custom) is silently removed (documented in the docstring). The antibody-derived tag counts of a CITE-seq run never reach the h5ad; the output is a valid, plausible RNA-only object and nothing is printed.

files.load_cite.py:
import scanpy as sc

adata = sc.read_10x_mtx("filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
adata.var[["gene_ids", "feature_types"]].to_csv("loaded_features.tsv", sep="\t")
adata.write_h5ad("cite_seq.h5ad")
files.load_cite_v2.py:
import scanpy as sc

adata = sc.read_10x_mtx("filtered_feature_bc_matrix", gex_only=False)
adata.var[["gene_ids", "feature_types"]].to_csv("loaded_features.tsv", sep="\t")
adata.write_h5ad("cite_seq.h5ad")
